result.reason: The revision confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data and appropriately narrows IBM’s licence to Type I Materials, but it does not reach either playbook position. Type II Materials may include deliverables created during the Services, yet IBM retains ownership and Customer receives only an Enterprise-limited licence that does not expressly permit modification or sublicensing. Nor is there an express assignment of all Customer-specific deliverables or a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded Vendor IP. The added copyright-notice requirement is unnecessary to achieve the playbook position. The drafting is generally professional, but the Type I/Type II structure leaves the key ownership outcome dependent on classification.
